input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is PAINTING STYLE ONLY, never copy its person, framing or pose. Keep the same face, headwear, clothes and single set of equipment. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. During collapse fall FORWARD AWAY from the camera, finally FACE-DOWN with the back uppermost and the face HIDDEN. Never turn to face the viewer, never roll onto the back. Adult woman, dark curly hair and blue hood, ivory/pale-blue split layered cloth, water glass charms, worn silver clasps, crescent orb staff. Compact mist and droplets. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, 16 separate complete poses of ONE SAME character. Read left to right, top to bottom. Row 1: four keys of a QUICK FLINCH AND RECOVERY: 1 ready upright pose; 2 sharp unmistakable recoil with shoulders and head pulled BACK by one head-width and torso bent back 25 degrees; 3 shoulders returning and braced bent legs; 4 upright recovered ready pose. These four poses MUST visibly differ, not four standing duplicates. Row 2: first four keys of a BIGGER STAGGER: 5 upright ready; 6 abrupt backward bend of upper body; 7 deepest backward bend, arms pulled close, balance visibly lost; 8 lower body catches the weight, bent knees or legs. Row 3: 9 pushing back upright, visibly struggling; 10 upright recovered. Then begin COLLAPSE: 11 ready upright; 12 legs buckle and body drops. Row 4: continue COLLAPSE: 13 body very low, leaning toward ground; 14 torso falls sideways nearly horizontal; 15 body settles FULLY LYING on its side, head and entire torso on ground; 16 body completely still FULLY LYING ON GROUND, legs extended or naturally folded, equipment resting beside it. The final TWO poses must be completely horizontal resting bodies, never crouching, kneeling, sitting or getting back up. Treat collapse as a harmless theatrical fall/rest pose, fully intact. No blood, gore, wounds or injury detail. No attacker, impact flash or effects. Each of the 16 equal cells contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 65% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only. CORRECTION: Rear-facing all the way: back of head, back cloak and spine face camera. Collapse FORWARD AWAY, face DOWN and HIDDEN in both final lying keys. The entire body AND staff fit in middle 60% of each cell, especially the bottom row. No clipped feet or weapons. Strong 25 degree torso flinch in key 2.

arguments.Prompt: Stylized concept character animation sheet on solid uniform pure magenta background (#FF00FF). 4x4 grid containing exactly 16 separate poses arranged in 4 rows and 4 columns, spaced with wide empty magenta gutters and no grid lines or borders. Hand-painted digital dark fantasy illustration style referencing the painting technique in reference-2.png (sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth, smooth opaque paint, no grain, no 3D render, no heavy cartoon outlines). The character is the exact same adult woman from reference-1.png: dark curly hair under a blue hood, ivory and pale-blue split layered robes/cloth, water glass charms, worn silver clasps, holding a crescent orb staff. Elevated 55-degree orthographic camera angle. All poses are in REAR-RIGHT three-quarter perspective: camera views the back of her head, spine, and cloak facing diagonally away from viewer toward upper-right, back surfaces clearly visible. Row 1 (Quick Flinch & Recovery): Pose 1 ready upright posture; Pose 2 sharp flinch recoil with head and shoulders pulled back and torso bent backward 25 degrees; Pose 3 shoulders returning forward with braced knees; Pose 4 upright recovered ready stance. Row 2 (Heavy Stagger): Pose 5 upright ready; Pose 6 abrupt backward torso recoil; Pose 7 extreme backward bend losing balance with arms pulled inward; Pose 8 lower body catching weight on deeply bent legs. Row 3 (Stagger Recovery into Collapse start): Pose 9 pushing back upright struggling; Pose 10 upright recovered; Pose 11 upright ready; Pose 12 legs buckling, whole body dropping downward. Row 4 (Collapse & Rest): Pose 13 body collapsed low toward floor; Pose 14 torso falling forward-downward almost horizontal; Pose 15 body fully lying face-down on the ground away from camera, back and cloak visible, face completely hidden; Pose 16 body completely still fully lying flat on ground face-down, crescent staff resting beside her on ground. Every single pose including lying poses fits fully within the middle 60% of its cell, no clipped limbs, no borders, no text, no floor plane except empty magenta.
